items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was the drummer. He had to go by the name of Spider Maxwell... but that was the only time we actually played together.

ctx.x: Right. I’ve got a few titles here of albums that might jog your memory. Here’s one called The Modern Touch. Benny Golson sextet, right? Jay Jay Johnson, Kenny Dorham, Wynton Kelly, Paul Chambers, and on drums, Max Roach.
Max Roach, who was called Spider Maxwell, I think, on this, because he had a contract with some other company
